releases.name: Termbeat 2026-07-19
releases.body: First version. Termbeat is a terminal that reacts to audio from a file or the microphone. It shipped with several terminal themes and modes for a visualizer, bars, and a few small games.

jobs.description: Audio reactive terminal that reacts to music or the microphone, with themes and small games.

releases.name: Threat Poller 2026-08-01
releases.body: Created the threat intel poller with three category rules for watched repos. Alerts now save to Postgres so they persist between runs. Added a read API that returns the latest alerts for the dashboard.

jobs.description: Background poller that watches GitHub repos by category, saves alerts to Postgres, and serves them over a read API.

releases.name: Threat Dash 2026-08-06
releases.body: First version of the threat dashboard. It shows poller results and lets you add and remove repos on the watchlist.

jobs.description: Dashboard page for the threat poller, with a watchlist you can add to and remove from.

releases.name: Aerophin Twin 2026-08-29
releases.body: Created the drawing set for two coffee machines and added parts lists for each part. Added a part drawings page with interactive 3D models.

jobs.description: Drawing set and interactive 3D part models for two coffee machine designs.

releases.name: Skwiggle Backend 2026-08-31
releases.body: Created the backend with a basic running check. Added a Railway config so it can deploy and restart on failure.

jobs.description: Small Express backend for the Skwiggle drawing game, set up to run on Railway.

releases.name: Skwiggle Mint Pin 2026-09-01
releases.body: Created the pin proxy for minting. It now accepts two kinds of credentials, adds a health check that tests the credential, and logs the real cause when pinning fails. Triggered a redeploy on Railway.

jobs.description: Proxy service that pins Skwiggle art to IPFS so it can be minted.

releases.name: Skwiggle 2026-09-02
releases.body: Version 107 rebuilds the wallet connection on the right network after a switch and shows the real reason when a mint fails. Version 3.9 replaced the page with the Vercel Stumbler and added Netlify as a platform.

releases.name: Skwiggle 2026-09-01
releases.body: Version 105 pointed minting at the live pin service and added a transfer event to the contract data. Version 106 cropped the phone frame off slideshow images and removed the AI filter button.

jobs.description: Never ending line drawing game with mint support, later replaced by a Vercel host stumbler.

releases.name: Tower Builder 2026-09-02
releases.body: First version of the tower builder game. This repo holds only the Vercel settings for now.

jobs.description: Beam building tower game that tests your design against wind and earthquakes.

releases.name: Tower Builder 2 2026-09-02
releases.body: First version of the second tower builder. It adds an info button that explains the rules.

jobs.description: Second version of the tower builder game, with an info button explaining the rules.

releases.name: Shitty Ass Trading App 2026-09-05
releases.body: Updated the app icon and header mark. Merged the magazine tabs into one, loaded leadership info on start, and added a way to dismiss wrong entries.

releases.name: Shitty Ass Trading App 2026-09-04
releases.body: The trading search now uses a real picker with all 539 members of congress.

releases.name: Shitty Ass Trading App 2026-09-03
releases.body: Added a food network panel and button, and a congressional trading search in the menu.

releases.name: Shitty Ass Trading App 2026-09-01
releases.body: Added an insider filings panel, deep links that copy a chain URL, and a visible build number. Refreshes now run every two minutes and back off only when limits are really hit.

releases.name: Shitty Ass Trading App 2026-08-30
releases.body: Let people skip setup and use a shared key. Sped up quotes and history by batching requests, and added a one day sparkline to each tile. Added backoff after rate limit errors and an orange title accent.

jobs.description: Stock tracker for restaurant and food industry tickers with news, recalls, filings, and sentiment.

releases.name: Bitfield Synth 2026-09-08
releases.body: Version 8 adds a hamburger drawer and a full bleed canvas. Version 9 follows with further refinements.

releases.name: Bitfield Synth 2026-09-05
releases.body: Version 7 adds image presets that are built into the page.

releases.name: Bitfield Synth 2026-06-12
releases.body: First version of the synth as a single page. The canvas is now clean, with a blue accent on the frame.

jobs.description: Pixel field visualizer driven by math expressions, audio, and images.

releases.name: Contracts 2026-09-10
releases.body: First draft of the contract app. A missing page file was restored so the app loads.

jobs.description: Draft a contract, sign it with a finger or mouse, and record its fingerprint on Polygon.
